description: This file defines the LeaveApplicationService class, which manages leave application processes including applying for leave, handling leave requests, managing leave entitlements, and interacting with workflow states within a Human Resource Management system.

classes.name: LeaveApplicationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for handling leave application logic, including creating, validating, and saving leave requests, as well as managing workflow states and related events.

methods.name: applyLeave
methods.description: Handles the process of applying for leave, validating the leave dates against maximum allowed periods, overlapping leaves, and work shift constraints before saving the leave request.

methods.name: saveLeaveRequest
methods.description: Saves the leave request to the database, manages leave entitlements, records comments, dispatches leave application events, and handles exceptions during the save process.

methods.name: getLeaveRequestStatus
methods.description: Determines the status of a leave request based on whether the leave date falls on a weekend or holiday, or if it requires approval.

methods.name: allowToExceedLeaveBalance
methods.description: Indicates whether an employee is allowed to exceed their leave entitlement (returns false in this implementation).

methods.name: getWorkflowItemForApplyAction
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate workflow state machine item for the leave application action, specifically for 'APPLY' actions.
